blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As the country prepares to host the 47th General Assembly of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (AIPA), House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III on Saturday called on Southeast Asian lawmakers to help strengthen regional cooperation to address shared concerns. AIPA President Dy made the statement as the parliamentary delegation gathered for a preparatory meeting in Makati City before the 49th Asean Summit formally commenced on Sunday, Nov. 15. He emphasized the importance of institutional partnership in making the issues in Southeast Asia heard by foreign leaders. READ: Dy urges AIPA cooperation on trafficking, […]...
